title: fix(verify): reject incomplete selected source inventories
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Selected preflight can omit an unreadable, unlisted supplier subtree and pass
+ An opt-in source-authenticated successor propagates traversal errors
+ Both manifest layouts and contained regular-file aliases remain covered
```

Adds only `research/selected-inventory-fail-closed/`. The production checker, frozen consumers, selected record and kappa are unchanged. The traversal is entry-bounded and rejects special source files rather than ignoring them.

[Investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2946). Exact source/assignment pins and the production-adoption handoff are included.

## Evidence

Before: both actual retained CLI fixtures pass with an extra `unlisted/extra.py` hidden under a mode-000 directory. Restoring access exposes the inventory mismatch.

After: the successor CLI rejects the inaccessible subtree without printing success, still rejects the accessible extra file, and passes after its removal.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-inventory-fail-closed/verify.py
python3.13 -I -B research/selected-inventory-fail-closed/verify.py
ruff check research/selected-inventory-fail-closed/*.py
```

All 59 groups pass without skips on Linux/WSL2, CPython 3.12.15 and 3.13.5, both normally and with `-O`. This includes all 26 inherited groups per engine, seven new groups, actual CLI controls and twelve injected traversal failures. Both engines pass the full 1,579-file selected source binding. Exact committed package bytes also match the tested files.

Base `95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867`; refreshed main `4bb3629e638edc9d70ea124eb50f80e71433be05`, priority revision 5. Changed archive-intake guidance was read; selected inputs and runtime sources are unchanged. Fresh overlap includes open/closed PRs and complete Discussion pagination.

Credit Douglas Colkitt, Mihir Srivastava/PR841, yssite/PR959 and Arham Tahir/PR2793. PR2921 addresses the related generated-payload comparator, not this selected source-closure boundary. Full supplier attribution is retained in the package.

## Merge danger

Two-way change, confined to a new opt-in package. Default adoption needs explicit source-pin migration and maintainer review. Inputs must remain stable during checking; this is not a concurrent-writer snapshot. No generic CI replay, hosted result, full construction replay, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.
